correctness.rationale: Exact classification of signed changes: U loop vectors, (q-1)L+(q-2)T distinct signed three-coordinate vectors and 2(q-1)-1_{endpoints unequal} nonloop endpoint vectors. For q>=3 all max-term coefficients are positive, giving equality iff every ordered pair appears and endpoints coincide. The complete looped directed graph admits an Eulerian tour of length q^2, and BEST plus the directed matrix-tree theorem gives (q!)^q linearized tours. Independent disjoint-block union bound proves the limiting probability, and direct literal enumeration of 73,079 source words, including all 59,049 ternary length-ten words plus full ternary shortest-maximizer census corroborates the proof. No infinite claim depends solely on finite computation.

The (q-2)T term is a genuinely nonbinary orientation-sensitive observation, and its exact sharp bound, first-onset q^2+1, de Bruijn extremizer classification, exact extremizer count and exponential saturation probability are all structural all-parameter consequences relevant to profile-channel analysis.
